# Third-party libraries

Kept here at fixed versions, unmodified, so the site makes no request to a CDN.

| File | Library | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `d3.min.js` | [D3](https://d3js.org) | 7.9.0 | ISC |
| `topojson-client.min.js` | [topojson-client](https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client) | 3.1.0 | ISC |

The world map shapes in `data/countries-110m.json` come from [world-atlas](https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas) 2.0.2 (ISC), built from Natural Earth data, which is in the public domain.
